### 5.0 Perform gene set enrichment

- Perform gene set enrichment of proteins using `enrichr`

```{r}

protein_split <- split(significantly_affected_proteins_df, significantly_affected_proteins_df$direction_group)

num_genes <- vapply(protein_split, nrow, 1)
# down->down   down->up   up->down     up->up
#        340        735         61         18
num_genes / sum(num_genes)



dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(protein_split)
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]    
    db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
        message(paste(a_database, a_group))
        # current_fcs <- a_temp_df$logfc[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
        current_genes <- a_temp_df$protein_name
        an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
        if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
            return(NULL)
        }
        an_enrichment_df$direction_group <- a_group
        an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
        an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
        Sys.sleep(5)
        return(an_enrichment_df)
    })
    db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
    return(db_df)
}))

kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)


# annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "04-annotated-pairwise-groups-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))
significant_gene_set_enrichment <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05 &
    (kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio > 0.1),]
significant_gene_set_enrichment$Group <- annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df$Group[match(significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df$Term)]


significant_gene_set_enrichment$ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")
write.csv(significant_gene_set_enrichment, file = file.path(output_dir, "04-pairwise-groups-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))
# Perform enrichment smplify



```

- We annotated these terms into higher groups outside R for ease of human readability and understanding. Plot the term enrichments. 

```{r}  

annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "04-annotated-pairwise-groups-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

    "down->down" = "#72A3C0", "up->up" = "#E0777D")


down_up_terms_df <- annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df[annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df$direction_group == "down->up",]

down_up_terms_df$Group <- factor(down_up_terms_df$Group, 
    levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
keep_levels <- levels(down_up_terms_df$Group)
keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]


ThePlot_1 <- ggplot(down_up_terms_df[down_up_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:10],],

ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + ggtitle("Down -> up proteins")
```
